title: A novel ROR1-targeting antibody-PROTAC conjugate promotes BRD4 degradation for solid tumor treatment.
why_not_strict_adc: The construct pairs an antibody with a PROTAC (targeted protein degradation) payload, not a classical cytotoxic small-molecule payload. Under the strict-ADC domain rubric used for gold_set.jsonl (antibody + covalently linked cytotoxic small-molecule payload + target-mediated delivery), this is an adjacent conjugate modality, not a gold-set member -- excluding it here is an ontology decision, not a query-capability-influenced one. ADC_QUERY_TERM does not match this paper's wording ("degrader-antibody conjugate", no "antibody-drug conjugate" phrase, no listed payload suffix), so if Stelligen's ADC intelligence scope is later broadened to include degrader-antibody conjugates as a payload class, this becomes concrete evidence for expanding ADC_QUERY_TERM. Kept here as a watchlist item rather than deleted, so that future scope decision has a real example to reason from.
